assetClass.description:
The {@link AssetClass} that will be persisted by this version. Children {@link AssetClass}es
, {@link ExpectedSensor}s, and Failure Modes will be persisted as well.

file.description:
The file object that contains the data to persist.
This file must be a `csv` file, since Excel files need a runtime installation before processing.

title:
Represents a version of an AssetClassDefinition. The actual data to persist
is stored entirely within the `file` field.
name: ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionVersion
